data.title: 毛利兰 · 樱花道场的温柔花嫁
data.description: 小兰穿着带浅蓝腰带的白色婚纱站在道场木廊，手边放着收好的护具与一束樱花；她先认真把裙摆整理得适合行走，再对镜头露出温暖而有力量的笑。
data.action: 道场木廊边收好护具整理婚纱，双手捧樱花束露出温暖有力的笑
data.lighting: soft spring light through blooming cherry branches
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, vertical framing
data.mood: 柔软与坚韧并存的花嫁
data.promptProse: Ran holds the cherry-blossom bouquet in both hands on the veranda, training pads beside her. Spring light passes through the flowers onto her hands.
data.animaCaption: Both hands hold the cherry-blossom bouquet above the training pads beside the veranda.
